notes.title: 🎮 Hidden Kitten: Day One Patch (v1.0.0.5) is Live! 🐱‍🚀
notes.content:
[b]Hello gamers! 😎[/b]

The day one patch for [b]Hidden Kitten (version 1.0.0.5)[/b] just went live!
[h3]🛠 Fixes[/h3]
[list]
  [*][b]Achievement 'Cat-astrophe'[/b]: Was not unlockable if a level was restarted after finding the 'Planet' .[/*]
  [*][b]Object Colorization[/b]: Objects covered by balloons would not be colorized if the balloon covering them was clicked on initially and the object was found later.[/*]
  [*][b]Achievement 'That's Insane!'[/b]: Was not unlockable if the level was restarted after finding the 'Balloon Dog', 'Willy' or the 'Heart' in 'Furry Fiesta Funpark' on the first try.[/*]
  [*][b]'Key' in 'Ad Astra'[/b]: Was not interactible after it appeared on the ground.[/*]
[/list]
Thanks to everyone who has been playing and especially to those who provided feedback! 🐈
Greetings from the Devs! 🤓
